correctness.rationale: The assigned affine branches have lengths 1/2, 2^-17, 2^-17, 2^-5761, whose sum is <1, so disjoint branches exist and all slopes exceed 1. For full-shift pressure P(t)=-b t+log(1+2e^-ct+e^-360ct), b=log 2, c=16log 2, the normalized log slopes are d=(0,1,360) with beta=1/16. Reconstructed alpha=-P'(t)=c(beta+mu), P''(t)=c^2 V>0 and spectrum L(alpha(t))=t+P(t)/alpha(t). Independent differentiation in alpha gives L''=(2PP''-alpha^2)/(alpha^3P''), so its sign is the analytic G(w)=2(beta w+logZ)V-(beta+mu)^2. Executed the package's 75-digit mpmath interval checker, then an independent 100-digit high-precision implementation plus strict interval-endpoint sign comparisons. The sign sequence at five increasing rational w is (-,+,-,+,-), yielding >=4 distinct sign-changing roots via continuity and analyticity, with alpha strictly monotone. Ma 2020 Theorems 2.2,4.2 supply the lower bounds n>=4 and r_T>=3. At least four, not exactly four, is established.
risks: The five sign enclosures prove four sign changes but not absence of a fifth or sixth; Ma's r_T=3 upper bound is six.
Numerical experiments alone are not a proof; the explicit full-shift thermodynamic identities, exact branch existence, outward intervals and Ma lower bounds are essential.

value.rationale: Two natural complexities of affine cookie-cutter Lyapunov spectra are physical branch count n and number of distinct expansion factors r_T. Prior results separately attain the sharp four-branch threshold and three-slope threshold, but do not show attainability together; a concrete 4/3 witness settles their joint feasibility, with only one duplicated middle slope. This is a motivated extremal structural construction that distinguishes physical multiplicity from essential slope count; not a routine renaming, computational curiosity, or parameter substitution of the earlier four-distinct-slope witness.
